offering_description.value: Develops and sells weight management, nutrition, energy, sports and personal care products to consumers through a network of independent distributors. Products are made in company and contract facilities and sold via direct selling.

primary_products.value: weight management shakes and meal replacements; protein and nutritional supplements; energy and sports nutrition drinks; teas and herbal beverages; personal care products

customer_segment.value: B2C: consumers buying nutrition products, including distributors using products personally; B2B: independent distributors who buy products to resell and build businesses

end_markets.value: nutrition and wellness; weight management; sports nutrition; personal care

revenue_model.value: product sales: nutrition and personal care products sold to independent distributors and members at discounted prices

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: formulates and markets branded nutrition products, sold through independent distributors to consumers; OEM / manufacturer: operates some manufacturing plants using sourced ingredients, plus contract manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: About 90 countries across Asia Pacific, North America, Europe, Latin America, Middle East and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: weight management, nutrition supplements, energy and sports products, and personal care sold through one network

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: network of independent distributors selling person to person; online: distributor and member ordering through company websites and apps

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: dietary supplement and food regulation (FDA, FTC, foreign authorities) plus direct selling and multi-level marketing rules
